newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 29.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- College lecturers call strike for Thursday, joining campus crisis in Ivory Coast that started over the jailing of three militant student leaders.
- We are not afraid of commercial competition, says U.S. State Department official Regina Brown in interview during visit with American business delegation.

- Government takes stock of its "sell-off" of Ivory Coast, says critical article assessing half-way mark in state's privatisation programme. Article appeared on the first of three "open days" organised by the privatisation committee.
- Negotiations between President Bedie's envoys and political party leaders on bringing the opposition into government progressing discreetly amid growing risks of failure.
